entries.title: Jonah 1 — Chapter Introduction
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Pulled up - On condition that they seek the Lord. This was on God's part with admirable constancy performed through six hundred years, perhaps the longest time of freedom from captivity they ever knew.
